arguments.problem: Proposal under review: migrate the invoicing service from nightly batch runs to streaming updates
arguments.output: Strongest opposing case: nightly batch gives a natural reconciliation boundary — every morning there is one authoritative ledger state. Streaming makes every discrepancy a moving target, and our two worst incidents were both reconciliation drift, not latency complaints. Nobody has asked for fresher invoices.

arguments.problem: Proposal under review: migrate the invoicing service from nightly batch runs to streaming updates
arguments.output: Turing test: Dana Whitfield, the ops lead who owns the nightly window and carries the reconciliation pager, would sign the step-2 case as written — the one-authoritative-morning-state argument is hers, in her words from the March incident review.

arguments.problem: Proposal under review: migrate the invoicing service from nightly batch runs to streaming updates
arguments.output: Adversary: a competitor's solutions engineer doing a bake-off demo, motivated to surface any invoice that disagrees with the ledger in front of the prospect, armed with our public status-page history and one afternoon.

arguments.problem: Proposal under review: migrate the invoicing service from nightly batch runs to streaming updates
arguments.output: Attack: during the demo, fire a burst of credit-note edits mid-stream and screenshot the invoice total disagreeing with the ledger for the 40 seconds the projection lags; batch never exposed that window because both views updated together at 2am.

arguments.problem: Proposal under review: migrate the invoicing service from nightly batch runs to streaming updates
arguments.output: Independence check: this attack was run by the proposal's own author, which weakens it; the finding that could change the decision is the visible-lag window, and it would — the migration is not approvable without a consistency story for in-flight edits.

arguments.problem: Proposal under review: migrate the invoicing service from nightly batch runs to streaming updates
arguments.output: Amend and commit: proposal amended to ship read-your-writes projections for invoice totals before any cutover, owner: payments team; accepted risk: streaming infra cost during the dual-run quarter. Batch retirement gated on four clean reconciliation weeks.
